newsitem.title: UK: MSAS to open Pudong warehouse in October.
newsitem.headline: MSAS to open Pudong warehouse in October.

text.p: International freight forwarder MSAS Cargo International said it will open during October a new office and warehouse facility in the Pudong Free Trade Zone, north east of Shanghai.
The company, a member of the London-based Ocean Group Plc said the office and warehouse cover 6,900 sq feet and 11,200 sq feet respectively.
The facility will also support operations in the nearby cities of Wuxi, Hangzhou and Suzhou, it added.

Separately it added that Golden Eagle International Forwarding Company Ltd, a Beijing-based joint venture with Sino-Trans and PekAir, made its first export shipment on October 3. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
